_readme: Copy this file to local/<client-slug>/questionnaire.json and fill it in.
assertions[] carry direct control-status declarations — the minimal manual input.
Valid status values: COMPLIANT | PARTIAL | GAP | NA | TBC.
List control ids with: python -m dpdpa controls
departments[] optionally carries the Parts A-M data-flow questionnaire blocks
(A Process, B Data collected, C Source, D Method, E Purpose, F Consent & notice,
G Systems & storage, H Internal access, I Sharing, J International, K Retention,

assertions.evidence: Security measures and industry-standard adherence marked Not Compliant in departmental review.
Platform is strictly B2B with corporate onboarding only; documented age-exposure assessment attached.
